title: Adaptive quant-variant onboarding and drift sentinel
creator: Lena Martinez
description: Create a repeatable, automated onboarding flow for new quantized model variants (INT8/GPTQ/AWQ/FP8) that pairs a performance profile artifact with statistical regression detection (the 'drift sentinel'). The flow should produce artifacts consumable by the serving runtime and Console (variant-manifest.json + quant-metadata.yaml), gate rollouts using canary buckets, and surface early regressions via an evaluation signal that combines latency/cost SLOs with output-quality drift metrics.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Onboarding pipeline produces a signed variant-manifest.json and quant-metadata.yaml for INT8/GPTQ/AWQ/FP8 inputs. 2) Canary rollout policy can be configured per-variant and respects latency and cost SLOs. 3) Drift sentinel computes per-prompt output-divergence (embedding cosine and log-prob delta) and flags regressions automatically in the Console with a clear severity mapping. 4) CI gating blocks merges when candidate variants exceed acceptable thresholds on golden-prompt suite. 5) Integration tests exist and pass against runtime-1.22 in staging.
technical_notes: Design: 1) Use a hybrid regression signal: weighted sum of 1) relative median latency delta (p50/p95), 2) per-token cost delta, and 3) output-quality divergence consisting of embedding cosine similarity on a curated 'golden prompt' set plus average log-prob delta for reference completions. 2) Implement a small, fast microbench harness (quant-bench) that runs quantized kernels with realistic batching and KV-cache warmup to capture steady-state latency and memory pressure. 3) Produce compact quant-metadata.yaml containing: quant-backend, calibration-seed, per-layer scale metadata fingerprint, sample-LL, and perf-bench snapshots. 4) Variant-manifest.json includes pin fields: model_id, variant_id, runtime-recommendation, compatible-fallbacks, and cost-estimate-per-1k-tokens. 5) Telemetry contract: runtime emits variant_id, bench_snapshot_id, golden_suite_id, p50/p95, tokens_generated, avg_embedding_cos, avg_logprob_delta, and canary_bucket. 6) Regression thresholds are configurable per-model-family via console.
rollout_plan: 1) Start with internal-only onboarding for 2 small OPT-family models. 2) Run parallel canaries: 1% internal traffic for 48 hours, then 5% for 72 hours, with automated pause on threshold violation. 3) If sentinel flags a regression, automatic rehearse: rerun microbench with longer KV warmup and isolate dataset where divergence occurs. 4) Escalation: on 'high' severity, open incident with oncall infra and block rollout; 'medium' creates a rollback job and notifies PL/PM. 5) Full GA only after 14-day stability window with no quality regressions and cost delta within configured bounds.
test_plan: CI: golden-prompt regression suite (200 prompts) + perf microbench smoke tests. Staging: end-to-end serve test with representative traffic replay (per-customer QPS profiles) for 72h. Canary tests: automated A/B analysis using per-token cost curves and output-similarity stats; require manual sign-off for any explanatory drift where avg_embedding_cos < 0.93 or avg_logprob_delta > 1.5. Add unit tests for metadata serializer and runtime telemetry contract schema validation.
telemetry: Dashboards: quant-onboard/variant-health (latency vs baseline, cost delta, embedding-sim distribution, regression-rate). Alerts: critical if p95 latency delta > 30% or avg_embedding_cos < 0.88 across golden suite. CI gate produces artifact with numeric summary uploaded to S3 and attached to PR. Integrate with Console to attach canary timeline to rollout graph.
